description: Place an existing local block definition. position uses target-space coordinates; scale defaults to [1,1,1], rotation is degrees. targetBlockHandle defaults to model space; use a named block or layout blockHandle to place it there. layer names an existing layer for the new reference (default: the current layer). Cyclic references are refused.

layer.description: Existing layer name; create it first with cad.create_symbol.

name: cad.insert_block
